summary: Pulse Biosciences filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 disclosing an at-the-market equity distribution agreement with Mizuho Securities USA as sales agent covering up to $85,000,000 of common stock. Mizuho earns a commission up to 3.0% of gross sales and receives expense reimbursement; sales occur under the existing Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-293596) declared effective February 27, 2026, via an accompanying prospectus supplement. The agreement replaces a prior August 6, 2026 accord with the same agent. No shares are obligated to be sold. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any disclosure about the terminated prior agreement.
